name: 打工橘喵
intro: 一只系着蓝领带的橘猫，每天准时上班，准时不想上班。
style: thick clean dark outlines, flat colors

stickers.caption: 收到
stickers.action: snaps upright, nods twice energetically and gives a big thumbs up with a confident grin, then relaxes back

stickers.caption: 好的
stickers.action: makes a big OK sign with one paw next to its face and winks, bouncing slightly, then back to start

stickers.caption: 在吗
stickers.action: peeks in from the right side of the cell with only head and one paw visible, waves the paw curiously, then slides back

stickers.caption: 不想上班
stickers.action: bursts into huge cartoon waterfall tears, shaking with sobs, necktie flapping, then calms a little and sniffles

stickers.caption: 无语
stickers.action: stares blankly with flat deadpan eyes, a big sweat drop slides down the forehead, three dots appear one by one above the head

stickers.caption: 谢谢老板
stickers.action: bows deeply with both paws pressed together in gratitude, sparkles around, rises back up with a happy smile

stickers.caption: 抱抱
stickers.action: opens both arms wide, leans forward for a hug with eyes closed and blushing, little hearts pop up, then back

stickers.caption: 摸鱼中
stickers.action: sits relaxed holding a small tea cup, sips with eyes closed, steam curls rising, sways happily side to side
